item.title: Design Systems in Practice
item.description:
Design systems promise consistency and speed, but the reality of building and maintaining them is more nuanced than most articles suggest.

Starting Small

The biggest mistake teams make is trying to build everything upfront. Start with your most common components—buttons, inputs, cards. These form the foundation everything else builds upon.

Documentation Matters

A component library without documentation is just code. Developers need clear examples, usage guidelines, and accessibility considerations. Tools like Storybook help, but they’re not a substitute for thoughtful documentation.
